description: This file provides asynchronous functions for evaluating JavaScript expressions and function calls within a Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) debugger context, specifically for use with the chromiumoxide crate. It includes utilities for handling exceptions and formatting error details.

methods.name: evaluate_expression_in_debugger<Output: DeserializeOwned>( page: &Page, call_frame_id: &debugger::CallFrameId, expression: impl Into<String>, ) -> Result<Output>
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates a JavaScript expression within a specific debugger call frame and deserializes the result into the specified output type.

methods.name: format_exception_details(details: &runtime::ExceptionDetails) -> String
methods.description: Formats exception details from the debugger into a human-readable string, including stack trace information if available.

methods.name: evaluate_function_call_in_debugger<Output: DeserializeOwned>( page: &Page, call_frame_id: &debugger::CallFrameId, function_expression: impl Into<String>, arguments: Vec<json::Value>, ) -> Result<Output>
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates a JavaScript function call with provided arguments within a specific debugger call frame, deserializing the result into the specified output type.
